result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets with high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. On your example that gives T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` that the sales-rep query uses and updated the Javadoc. Closed tickets and other regions are filtered out as before.

The full offline `mvn -q -o test` run passes with no output. I didn't add a test for the new order, so nothing checks your T-1 to T-5 example directly.
